ops.body: - Keeping every offer at the walk's end re-reads the replay after the snap, which can drop a capture edit made while it ran (G15 audit 9; the same as Keep on a card)
- The first replay's "Not now" is a small grey text, and a person who is done can't tell it also leaves the gap question (G15 audit 11; ui-patterns "Found before quiet")

argv: Map layers and markers (MapLibre RN v11)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** end a walk that had a gap offered (force-quit the app for a few minutes while walking), watch the replay to its card. **Expect:** "Keep the likely way?" sits above the card with two outlined buttons; with VoiceOver or TalkBack on, it is announced; Back on Android leaves the replay and the question does not return. Keep it draws the stretch solid and the distance grows. (G15)
